Premise: re-read on main `9a8bb83d` by the card thread: holds, with one correction. The header stage menu (`RecordStageMenu`, from PR #35938) already carries a second pre-check and form (`plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordPathStageChange.tsx`, `fieldsNeededAt` + `collectFields`). So there are two copies today, not one.

PR 2 (`Fixes #35956`) moves the header stage menu onto the same copy and deletes the one in `recordPathStageChange.tsx`; it does not wait on #35853 and starts in a new session after PR 1 merges. The record drawer (per-field `onFieldSave`, no single-write path) is out of this card and gets a follow-up card.

Premise (thread, main `9a98a467`): holds. The card's acceptance names four places (list cell, record page inline, header stage change, kanban) and "one prediction and one fill-in dialog left in the repo". The record drawer is not in the acceptance and is its own card, #35995, so this PR closes the card.
Basis: card #35956 (epic #34571, listed under it by the maintainer 2026-11-21 07:59:12Z); split agreed with the seat.
Scope, the seat's reading:
1. The header stage menu's confirm is always the shared dialog. With nothing to fill in, it shows only the record name, "Stage: X" and the move button, and Enter still confirms. The older `record:path` confirm is not touched.
2. A server 409 keeps the stage menu's existing handling: a note in the dialog that someone else changed the record and the latest is shown, then a re-read. It does not move to the conflict-compare dialog. That move is a candidate follow-up if wanted.
3. The shared prediction skips types that cannot be edited in place (rich text and similar). Such a field no longer prompts in the stage menu and takes the refusal notice instead, per card item 6.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #36009 and #35923 do not touch these files. #35980 (dialog look; thread open, no PR yet) changes global dialog styling, so whichever lands second merges. `overlap-check.mjs` runs before each push. L1 at L1-a. The PR carries `Fixes #35956`.
